title: Kowloon Rising
author: J. M. Voss
blurb: Sable Winterbourne, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
